author: Attack
text:
v0.4 Phase 1: generalize lernie dispatch CLI for arbitrary roles

Refactor the dispatch CLI from a per-role Subcommand variant into a
positional <role> + optional --goal flag, and introduce a worker role
alongside the existing compactor.

CLI: lernie dispatch <role> <repo> <branch> [--goal <text>]
  - compactor: built-in goal; --goal is rejected.
  - worker:    --goal required; soul from <repo>/souls/worker.md.

Internals:
  - Dispatcher trait collapses to dispatch(role, repo, branch, goal).
  - prompt::subagent::spawn_subagent_branch carries the branch+worktree
    spawn and dispatch commit (goal.md, optional soul.md) shared by
    compactor and worker. Compactor::run is behavior-stable.
  - prompt::worker::run lands the dispatch commit per ARCH §2.3 step 2
    and exits; worker step loop, dispatch/await tools, and merge-back
    are subsequent v0.4 phases.

E2E test in tests/dispatch_worker_e2e.rs covers the worker shape under
real git plus per-role argument validation. Coverage stays at 100%.
